statement: 用户在完整获知无法保证成功、过去 refiner 失败证据、两轮止损边界以及先执行 no-weight-update deterministic blend feasibility 的具体方案后明确回复‘execute’。现批准执行 hash-bound config configs/foundir_blur_only_flux2_scalar_residual_feasibility_v1.json：exact FLUX step-10k；512 个既有 isolated-Blur training source groups 固定为 selection_rank 0–383 calibration 与 384–511 validation；仅 calibration 按预声明 grid/rule 选择 alpha，validation 单次 gate；严禁 development GT 调参或访问、模型权重更新、自动 full-development、自动 residual-network training、Qwen degradation conditioning、mixed degradation、distillation、decoder tuning、sealed internal 和 official FoundIR test。该记录只绑定本次 USER 明确授权‘execute’，是 USER authorization，不代表或捏造 advisor 回复。
